P3
Give the hosting facts for TRUST_PROXY (NEW-18)
How is the app reached — directly, or behind proxies? And which ones? Decides how serious the proxy-addr finding actually is.
Q1: should a legacy admin see term budgets?
Today only finance:view unlocks budgets, so a legacy admin sees none — but the AI audit treats legacy admins as fully authorized. Inconsistent; pick one.
Q2: may budget/balance totals go to Google?
The AI prompt sends society name, budget and balance (no individual transactions). Your D-B10 rule bans transaction data — are these totals acceptable?
Q3: which Gemini model, and who sets the key?
Server default is gemini-1.5-pro; the old frontend used gemini-3-flash-preview. Without GEMINI_MODEL/GEMINI_API_KEY set server-side, the AI audit just answers 503.
Q4: where is the PWA work from your project history?
Your history says 197 PWA tests passed, but no PWA code exists anywhere in this repo (checked every git ref). Different repo, never saved, or should one be built now?
Q5: add Cache-Control: no-store to API responses?
The backend sends no cache header today, so financial/personal data could be cached by a browser or proxy. Small, recommended hardening.
Q6: calendar events aren't saved to the backend at all
Found while reviewing the frontend fixes — "Save Event" only updates local state and never calls the API. Intentional, or a real bug to fix?
Q7: which permission should gate each create/edit page?
The societies/events/projects/reports/announcements new+edit routes have no permission check in the UI (the backend still enforces it server-side).
Commit the Backend and Frontend agent changes?
Both are now fully reviewed AND independently re-tested by me (not just reported). Sitting uncommitted in wave2-backend / wave2-frontend.

8 integration files that never started (out of memory) + the flaky socket-reconnect spec — needs free memory.
